summary: Full backend + frontend test of vMix Overlay Studio. 29 pytest tests all pass (auth incl. MFA login/register/setup-verify, wrong password/wrong code 401, sources CRUD incl. builtin_weather/builtin_time/custom with open-meteo, sources/test resolves numeric temperature, scenes CRUD, all public vMix endpoints /data.json /data.xml /overlay /values.json /settings return valid data without auth, regenerate-token invalidates the old public link). Frontend Playwright test also passed the full happy path: MFA login (TOTP from JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP) reaches /dashboard, Scenes page opens editor, all 5 add-element buttons (text, clock, image, timed_text, api_field) add elements and show the properties-panel, Save works, Export navigates to /export with all 4 URL codes (overlay/datajson/dataxml/settings) and regen-token-btn changes the token in place. Sources page create flow works and shows 'Source saved' toast.

issues: React a11y warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent. Minor accessibility polish – add DialogDescription.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Add DialogDescription to shadcn Dialogs in Scenes.jsx and Sources.jsx to silence Radix a11y warnings.

(Optional) build_scene_data uses server-side datetime.now(UTC) for clock columns in data.json which ignores the element's configured timezone/format; the browser overlay handles this correctly, so acceptable for MVP but could be aligned.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/auth/login for a not-yet-MFA-enabled user returns a 200 with the TOTP secret in the response body based solely on email+password. This is intentional per the design (self-serve MFA setup) but means anyone who guesses/knows a user's password can retrieve their TOTP secret. Consider gating this behind a signed one-time setup token from the /register response.

server.py: seed_admin overwrites the admin's TOTP secret with ADMIN_TOTP_SECRET on every restart. Fine for the automated test admin, but for real deployments this hard-codes a well-known secret if the env var is not rotated.
server.py CORS: allow_origins uses a single FRONTEND_URL from env; good. But CORS_ORIGINS='*' in backend/.env is unused – dead config, minor cleanup.
server.py: no rate limiting / brute force lockout on /auth/login or /auth/mfa/verify (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout requirement). Not blocking MVP but flagged.
server.py resolve_source_values catches all exceptions when fetching URL and silently returns previous raw. Good for resilience; last_error is surfaced via /test.
SceneEditor.jsx: 'Save' button label doesn't show 'Saving…' because the reactive block is bound to icon-only SecondaryButton children; behavior is minor.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed sources and scene. Cleanup fixture deletes created sources. Test scene is deleted at end of TestScenes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses pyotp against ADMIN_TOTP_SECRET=JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP. Uses requests.Session for the admin cookie jar. Open-meteo is real – if it's flaky, TestSources.test_test_source_weather may need retry. Frontend uses httpOnly cookies with samesite=none/secure; test only via https public URL, not localhost.
